fields.description:
Update the author-facing documentation so writers know to de-risk risky runtime mechanisms out-of-loop before committing them to a slow delivery loop — the behavior T15 rewards.

## Work
- Edit `src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md`, surfaced by `rebar explain plan`, to explain that when correctness only resolves after a slow codified delivery loop such as CI/CD, IaC apply, or provisioning, the plan names the risky mechanisms and commits to a concrete fast out-of-loop proof before codifying.
- State that the proof is either a local run or a manual probe against the real target.
- State that throwaway experiments are cleaned up with teardown scoped only to resources they created.
- Inspect `docs/plan-review-gate.md`; if its hand-authored content enumerates overlay criteria, add a one-line T15 pointer consistent with the generated criteria guide. The generated guide itself is owned by the criterion story, not this story.
- Keep all guidance stack-agnostic; CI/CD, IaC apply, and provisioning are mechanism classes, not product-specific instructions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `rebar explain plan` renders guidance to name risky mechanisms whose correctness resolves only after a slow codified delivery loop.
- [ ] `rebar explain plan` renders the two permitted fast proof forms: a local run or a manual probe against the real target.
- [ ] `rebar explain plan` renders cleanup guidance that limits teardown to resources created by the throwaway experiment.
- [ ] The new guidance does not hardcode Terraform, Docker, or another product-specific stack.
- [ ] If `docs/plan-review-gate.md` enumerates overlays, its hand-authored content references T15 consistently with the generated guide.
- [ ] Existing `rebar explain plan` guide rendering remains intact outside the new guidance.

## Testing
- Run `.venv/bin/rebar explain plan` and verify the rendered slow-loop, local-or-manual-proof, and scoped-cleanup guidance.
- Run `.venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/test_packaged_explain_guides.py -q` to prove the packaged guide still renders through the supported explain surface; use the nearest existing guide test if the repository names that contract differently.
- Inspect `docs/plan-review-gate.md` against `docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md` for consistent T15 naming when the hand-authored document enumerates overlays.
